coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: Command role details are tiny, while tyres and optics could drift into generic primitives rather than informative functional forms.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Floor3 supported for source artwork: tall aerials, cross-bustle poles/cases/reel, short dummy gun/optic head and wedge/trailer wheel hierarchy provide sparse secondary explanation at native256. Tertiary noise is restrained. OP optical end contrast remains an advisory; no new microdetail demand.

coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: Faceted cylinders and sharp plates could look like unrelated construction vocabularies; the trailer could become an ungrounded angular toy.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Floor3 supported: vehicle additions retain deliberate planar armour, faceted cast/socket forms and narrow pole/reel primitives consistent with the base. The revised tyre rounded body and low-profile chevrons now separate rubber from plate construction without oversized paddles. No speculative bevel pass required.

coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: All-olive equipment may vanish against the turret; burned W01 accessories could merge into a dark lump.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Floor3 supported: dark undercarriage/tyres establish the lowest band, olive main masses remain clear, subdued canvas and reel/case contrasts are scarce accents. W01 dark turret and equipment still retain distinct edges and collapse geometry. Not a claim of lighting qualification.

coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: Large padded diagnostics could hide weakness at gameplay size, and one favorable view might conceal openings or supports.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Visual legibility floor3 supported by native256 thumbnails plus opposing sides, front, top, underside and exposed-state diagnostics. Camera/pivot/scale/lighting/runtime-format/performance/fallback requirements explicitly excluded by this exact visual-only profile are not applicable. No transparent frame, anchor or runtime-format failure is asserted. Front-only command wreck role discrimination remains advisory.
